name: Yale Linus Smart Lock L2 (EU)

radios.note: Brochure lists Bluetooth 5.3 and Wi-Fi 2.4-5 GHz. The CSA listing shows Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

matter.note: Matter arrived by firmware update (lock firmware 2.0.20+, Yale Home app 2024.11.0+). CSA lists the L2 (product ID 0x4002) with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth; the L2 Lite is a separate Thread model.

apple_home.note: Listed by Yale. Yale's troubleshooting pages mention occasional 'No response' issues in Apple Home.

home_assistant.note: Yale's main platform list does not include Home Assistant, but Yale UK's Matter page names it as the Matter hub that currently offers separate Unlock and Open Door actions. Home Assistant's own Yale (cloud) integration marks the L2 as unsupported, so Matter is the route.

hubRequired.note: Built-in Wi-Fi, so no Yale bridge is needed; Yale says only the partner platform's own hub is needed for Matter.

localControl.note: No Yale source states local-only control.

lockFit.note: Fits over an existing Euro-profile cylinder that sticks out at least 3 mm, per the brochure; Yale says an incompatible cylinder may need replacing.

keypad.note: No keypad on the lock; Yale says PIN access needs the separate Yale Smart Keypad. The Yale Dot is another optional accessory.

power.note: Rechargeable Li-ion pack charged over USB-C after removing it from the lock; up to 6 months per charge, per the brochure.

summary: The Yale Linus Smart Lock L2 is a retrofit lock for European doors with built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. A firmware update added Matter over Wi-Fi, and Yale lists Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings as supported platforms. It runs on a rechargeable battery and has no keypad of its own; the Yale Dot is an optional accessory.
caveats: Matter needs lock firmware 2.0.20 or later and Yale Home app 2024.11.0 or later.
Yale says controlling the lock through a Matter hub is more limited than in the Yale Home app.
Yale's troubleshooting pages note Apple Home can report 'No response' after iOS updates.
